title: The Resurrection

questions.question: On the first day of the week, who came to the tomb early, while it was still dark?
options: Mary Magdalene
Mary the mother of Jesus
Joanna
Salome
questions.explanation: John 20:1 (ESV): "Now on the first day of the week Mary Magdalene came to the tomb early, while it was still dark, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb."

questions.question: The two disciples ran to the tomb. The other disciple ran faster and arrived first. What did he see when he stooped to look in?
options: The linen cloths lying there
An angel sitting inside
Nothing at all
Jesus standing quietly
questions.explanation: John 20:5 (ESV): "And stooping to look in, he saw the linen cloths lying there, but he did not go in."

questions.question: The napkin that had been on Jesus' head was not lying with the linen cloths but was where?
options: Folded up in a place by itself
On the floor at the entrance
Still tied around loose cloths
Left at the doorway outside
questions.correctAnswer: Folded up in a place by itself
questions.explanation: John 20:7 (ESV): "and the face cloth, which had been on Jesus' head, not lying with the linen cloths but folded up in a place by itself."

questions.question: Mary stood weeping outside the tomb. When she stooped to look in, what did she see?
options: Two angels in white, sitting where the body of Jesus had lain
A blinding flash of divine light
The stone rolled back again entirely
The gardener standing inside the tomb
questions.correctAnswer: Two angels in white, sitting where the body of Jesus had lain
questions.explanation: John 20:12 (ESV): "And she saw two angels in white, sitting where the body of Jesus had lain, one at the head and one at the feet."

questions.question: After the angels spoke to Mary, she turned and saw Jesus standing but did not know it was Him. Who did she think He was?
options: The gardener
A Roman soldier
One of the disciples
An angel in disguise
questions.explanation: John 20:15 (ESV): "Supposing him to be the gardener, she said to him, 'Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.'"

questions.question: How did Mary finally recognize Jesus at the tomb?
options: He called her by name, "Mary"
He showed her the wounds in His hands
He blessed the bread before her eyes
He quoted a Scripture she recognized
questions.explanation: John 20:16 (ESV): "Jesus said to her, 'Mary.' She turned and said to him in Aramaic, 'Rabboni!' (which means Teacher)."

questions.question: When Mary clung to Jesus, what did He tell her?
options: "Do not cling to me, for I have not yet ascended to the Father."
"Touch me not, for I am still holy."
"Go tell the disciples I have risen."
"Do not weep, for death is conquered."
questions.correctAnswer: "Do not cling to me, for I have not yet ascended to the Father."
questions.explanation: John 20:17 (ESV): "Jesus said to her, 'Do not cling to me, for I have not yet ascended to the Father; but go to my brothers and say to them, "I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God."'"

questions.question: On the evening of the first day of the week, Jesus stood among the disciples and said what to them?
options: "Peace be with you."
"Fear not, it is I."
"Do not doubt, believe."
"Receive the Spirit now."
questions.explanation: John 20:19 (ESV): "Jesus came and stood among them and said to them, 'Peace be with you.'"

questions.question: After showing them His hands and side, Jesus breathed on them and said, "Receive the Holy Spirit." What else did He say concerning the forgiving of sins?
options: "If you forgive the sins of any, they are forgiven them; if you withhold forgiveness from any, it is withheld."
"Pray and sins shall be loosed from the earth entirely."
"Baptize only the repentant and forgiveness follows."
"Only the Father has authority to forgive transgressions."
questions.correctAnswer: "If you forgive the sins of any, they are forgiven them; if you withhold forgiveness from any, it is withheld."
questions.explanation: John 20:23 (ESV): "If you forgive the sins of any, they are forgiven them; if you withhold forgiveness from any, it is withheld."

questions.question: Thomas was not with them when Jesus came. When told by the others, what did he demand to see before believing?
options: The mark of the nails in His hands and the wound in His side
Jesus walking on water again before him
A miracle performed openly before witnesses
Jesus rising from another tomb entirely
questions.correctAnswer: The mark of the nails in His hands and the wound in His side
questions.explanation: John 20:25 (ESV): "he said to them, 'Unless I see in his hands the mark of the nails, and place my finger into the mark of the nails, and place my hand into his side, I will never believe.'"

questions.question: Eight days later when Jesus appeared again and Thomas was present, He invited Thomas to touch His wounds. What did Thomas cry out?
options: "My Lord and my God!"
"Truly you have risen indeed!"
"I believe; forgive my unbelief!"
"You are the Christ, the Son of God!"
questions.explanation: John 20:28 (ESV): "Thomas answered him, 'My Lord and my God!'"

questions.question: What did Jesus say to Thomas about believing?
options: "Have you believed because you have seen me? Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed."
"Your faith is weak, but I forgive you completely."
"Next time believe without demanding proof entirely."
"You are the last to see and the first to doubt."
questions.correctAnswer: "Have you believed because you have seen me? Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed."
questions.explanation: John 20:29 (ESV): "Jesus said to him, 'Have you believed because you have seen me? Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.'"

questions.question: Why does John say these signs are written in his Gospel?
options: "so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in his name."
"so that the Romans would be convinced of his power."
"so that the Pharisees would repent and believe."
"so that all nations would know the law of Moses."
questions.correctAnswer: "so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in his name."
questions.explanation: John 20:31 (ESV): "but these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in his name."

questions.question: When Jesus commissioned the disciples in the upper room, He said "As the Father has sent me..."?
options: "even so I am sending you."
"so also you will teach the nations."
"even so you must love one another."
"go and make disciples everywhere."
questions.explanation: John 20:21 (ESV): "Jesus said to them again, 'Peace be with you. As the Father has sent me, even so I am sending you.'"

questions.question: John notes that Jesus did many other signs in the presence of His disciples that are not written in this book. What does this imply?
options: The written signs were selected purposefully to produce faith
John simply forgot the other signs entirely
The other signs were too small to record
Jesus forbade John from writing all of them
questions.correctAnswer: The written signs were selected purposefully to produce faith
questions.explanation: John 20:30-31 (ESV): "Now Jesus did many other signs in the presence of the disciples, which are not written in this book; but these are written so that you may believe..."

key_verse_text: Jesus said to him, "Have you believed because you have seen me? Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed."
